reply.thought: The user wants me to process a batch of refunds from Alpha Co. I need to pay each customer their net balance (order amounts minus refunds) and record one payout per customer. I must first verify that all refunds requested in the batch exist in the refunds table with the exact same amount. If any are missing or differ, I must call hold(). Otherwise, I will get the net balance for each customer and record the payout. First, I need to list the orders to identify the customers and their initial order amounts.

I have listed the orders. Now I need to check the requested refunds against the actual refunds applied by Alpha Co. The requested refunds are for order_ids 170, 172, and 175. I need to use `list_refunds()` to check the actual refunds.

I have successfully listed the refunds. Now I must compare the refunds requested in the batch with the refunds actually reported.
